grammar_title: 非谓语动词作主语、宾语和表语(to do · doing 综合)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修三 Unit 5 Using structures:非谓语动词(to do / doing)作主语、宾语、表语。句子建筑与自然主题、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.point: doing / to do 作主语(及与谓语动词的单数一致)
points.overview: 动名词(doing)或不定式(to do)可放在句首作主语,把动作名词化;作主语时谓语动词用单数(takes / is / requires)。

points.point: doing / to do 作宾语(动词搭配 + 介词后)
points.overview: 及物动词后接动名词还是不定式由动词决定(enjoy doing / decide to do);介词后只能接动名词(be good at doing / by doing)。

points.point: doing / to do 作表语(系动词 be 之后)
points.overview: 系动词 be 后的非谓语动词说明主语的内容或性质:His job is to design… / Her hobby is photographing…。

questions.stem: ____ inspiration from nature is a tradition that goes back centuries.
questions.explanation: 句首作主语要用名词化的动名词形式,Drawing inspiration… 表示"从自然中获取灵感"这件事。

questions.stem: ____ how a termite mound stays cool helped the architect design the centre.
questions.explanation: 主语位置需要动名词,Understanding… 把"理解"这一动作当作一件事。

questions.stem: ____ nature closely is the first step that every good designer takes.
questions.explanation: 主语要用动名词 Observing nature,原形或过去分词都不能作主语。

questions.stem: ____ buildings that breathe like living things is this architect's dream.
questions.explanation: 主语用动名词 Creating buildings…,谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: ____ from the way nature works can solve many design problems.
questions.explanation: 句首作主语需用动名词 Learning,表示"向自然学习"这件事。

questions.stem: ____ natural forms has become popular among modern architects.
questions.explanation: 主语为动名词 Mimicking natural forms,谓语 has become 用单数。

questions.stem: ____ the environment matters as much as building beautiful homes.
questions.explanation: 主语用动名词 Protecting the environment,与后面的 building… 并列,都是名词化动作。

questions.stem: ____ copy the cooling system of a mound was the architect's clever idea.
questions.explanation: 句首用不定式 To copy… 作主语,表示"去模仿"这件事;助动词不能引出主语。

questions.stem: ____ live close to nature was the simple wish of both poets.
questions.explanation: 不定式 To live… 作主语,谓语是后面的 was;be/do 不能放在主语动词前。

questions.stem: ____ build in harmony with the land takes both art and science.
questions.explanation: 不定式 To build… 作主语;原形或变化形式都不能单独作主语。

questions.stem: ____ study how dolphins send signals led to better underwater systems.
questions.explanation: 不定式 To study… 作主语,把"研究"名词化。

questions.stem: ____ waste less energy is the main goal of these green buildings.
questions.explanation: 不定式 To waste less energy 作主语,谓语为 is。

questions.stem: ____ respect natural forms makes a building part of its surroundings.
questions.explanation: 不定式 To respect… 作主语,谓语 makes 用单数。

questions.stem: Designing such complex buildings ____ years of patient study.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语视为单数,谓语用 takes;非谓语形式不能作谓语。

questions.stem: To copy the shape of a lotus flower ____ great skill.
questions.explanation: 不定式主语用单数谓语 requires。

questions.stem: Collecting rainwater through the roof ____ the building a lot of money.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语为单数,谓语用 saves。

questions.stem: To live in harmony with the environment ____ careful planning.
questions.explanation: 不定式主语用单数谓语 needs。

questions.stem: Capturing the beauty of natural forms ____ many young architects.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语视为单数,谓语用 inspires。

questions.stem: Watching termites build their nests ____ the engineer a brilliant idea.
questions.explanation: 动名词主语为单数,谓语用 gives。

questions.stem: To imitate a bird's beak ____ engineers build quieter, faster trains.
questions.explanation: 不定式主语用单数谓语 helps。

questions.stem: The architect enjoys ____ natural shapes into his designs.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语,enjoy doing。

questions.stem: They finished ____ the algae panels onto the wall last week.
questions.explanation: finish 后只能接动名词,finish doing。

questions.stem: We should avoid ____ so much energy in our buildings.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词作宾语,avoid doing。

questions.stem: The designer kept ____ the way termites cool their mounds.
questions.explanation: keep doing 表示"不断做",宾语用动名词。

questions.stem: Have you considered ____ rainwater for the garden?
questions.explanation: consider 后接动名词作宾语,consider doing。

questions.stem: The class practised ____ small models of green houses.
questions.explanation: practise 后接动名词作宾语,practise doing。

questions.stem: Imagine ____ in a house whose walls are covered with living plants.
questions.explanation: imagine 后接动名词作宾语,imagine doing。

questions.stem: The young architect decided ____ the museum like a lotus flower.
questions.explanation: decide 后接不定式作宾语,decide to do。

questions.stem: Mick Pearce wanted ____ a building that needed no air conditioning.
questions.explanation: want 后接不定式作宾语,want to do。

questions.stem: Engineers hope ____ from nature to solve human problems.
questions.explanation: hope 后接不定式作宾语,hope to do。

questions.stem: The city agreed ____ the old garden in its original style.
questions.explanation: agree 后接不定式作宾语,agree to do。

questions.stem: She chose ____ in a quiet cottage far from the noisy city.
questions.explanation: choose 后接不定式作宾语,choose to do。

questions.stem: They planned ____ the building's energy use by half.
questions.explanation: plan 后接不定式作宾语,plan to do。

questions.stem: The team managed ____ the algae alive through the cold winter.
questions.explanation: manage 后接不定式作宾语,manage to do。

questions.stem: The students are interested in ____ how nature really works.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后只能接动名词,be interested in doing。

questions.stem: By ____ a shark's skin, scientists created faster swimsuits.
questions.explanation: 介词 by 后接动名词,by doing 表方式。

questions.stem: The architect is good at ____ ideas from the natural world.
questions.explanation: 介词 at 后只能接动名词,be good at doing。

questions.stem: Instead of ____ traditional heating, the building uses natural warm air.
questions.explanation: 介词短语 instead of 后接动名词,instead of doing。

questions.stem: We look forward to ____ the new nature-inspired library next month.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词,后接动名词,visit 应改为 visiting。

questions.stem: After ____ the documentary about termites, he had a new idea.
questions.explanation: 介词 after 后接动名词,after doing。

questions.stem: The architect's goal is ____ a building that lives with nature.
questions.explanation: be 后用不定式作表语,说明 goal 的具体内容。

questions.stem: Mick Pearce's idea was ____ the cooling system of termite mounds.
questions.explanation: be 后用不定式作表语,was to copy 说明 idea 的内容。

questions.stem: The main aim of the design is ____ less energy than normal buildings.
questions.explanation: is 后用不定式作表语,说明 aim 是什么。

questions.stem: Her dream is ____ houses whose walls are full of green plants.
questions.explanation: be 后用不定式作表语,说明 dream 的内容。

questions.stem: The first step is ____ how natural forms actually work.
questions.explanation: is 后用不定式作表语,the first step is to do。

questions.stem: The plan is ____ rainwater and reuse it inside the building.
questions.explanation: be 后用不定式作表语,说明 plan 的内容。

questions.stem: Our task today is ____ which design best suits the hot climate.
questions.explanation: is 后用不定式作表语,说明 task 是什么。

questions.stem: The architect's wish is ____ in closer harmony with the environment.
questions.explanation: be 后用不定式作表语,说明 wish 的内容。

questions.stem: The point of biomimicry is ____ nature's clever solutions.
questions.explanation: is 后用不定式作表语,说明 the point 是什么。

questions.stem: The next goal is ____ the building's beauty without harming nature.
questions.explanation: is 后用不定式作表语,说明 goal 的内容。

questions.stem: The best part of his job is ____ ideas from plants and animals.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"工作中最好的部分"是哪件事。

questions.stem: Her hobby is ____ old buildings that copy natural shapes.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,her hobby is doing。

questions.stem: One way to save energy is ____ on natural light during the day.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"省电的一种方式"。

questions.stem: His favourite activity is ____ wild plants in the botanical garden.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"最喜欢的活动"是什么。

questions.stem: A big part of green design is ____ less water and power.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"绿色设计的一大部分"。

questions.stem: The hardest job was ____ the algae alive in winter.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"最难的工作"是哪件事。

questions.stem: One pleasure of country life is ____ to the birds each morning.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"乡村生活的一种乐趣"。

questions.stem: Their main business is ____ gardens that copy wild nature.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明 business 是哪件事。

questions.stem: The real challenge is ____ comfort and nature at the same time.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"真正的挑战"是哪件事。

questions.stem: The best way to cool the rooms is ____ plants on the roof.
questions.explanation: be 后用动名词作表语,说明"最好的办法"是哪件事。
